verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for a package manager, since registry-backed package managers can issue scoped tokens. However, nothing in the evidence shows Homebrew issuing any API credentials, scoped or otherwise. Least-privilege-adjacent items such as non-admin installs, HOMEBREW_NO_SUDO and per-item tap trust are different controls and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
